utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you decided what to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still deciding, but I can probably bring some tools and a box of screws.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That sounds useful—can you bring a screwdriver set too?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand and a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I might take you up on that. I’m a bit scattered today, so I may need a reminder about what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Noah — I can help keep track of it. Just tell me what’s left, and I’ll jot it down for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—people have been dropping things off all morning. If you want, I can tell you what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that’d be helpful—do they still need boxes or any tools? I just want to make sure I bring the right thing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes—boxes would still help, and they could use a few basic tools too. If you’ve got packing tape, that’d be great as well.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you take the donated tools over to the community center at 3 Maple Street and set them by the front desk?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll take the donated tools to 3 Maple Street and leave them by the front desk.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling everyone about it—want me to spread the word to a few more neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, that’d help a lot. Thanks, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll let a few folks know right away. If you want, I can also mention what tools or supplies they should bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Leo — I’ve got the repair drive organized, and I’m ready to help coordinate the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll stop by and help however I can. Let me know what you need first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — first I’d love help sorting the donation list and setting up the tools table. If you can come by tomorrow afternoon, we’ll get a good start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’m sorry, I don’t have the details in front of me yet. If you tell me what part you need, I’ll help fill it in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries — let me know when you have the details, and I’ll double-check them before we do anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around the school schedule first. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I was thinking Saturday morning, after school drop-off but before lunchtime. Does that fit your schedule?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning should work for me after drop-off. If you share the exact time, I’ll make sure I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard about the repair drive, but I’m still getting the details second-hand. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve only heard that it’s coming together, and folks are still sorting the final details. If you want, I can help keep you posted as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — I’d appreciate that. I’m still a bit out of the loop, so any updates would help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — what’s the main thing I need to know about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the repair drive is still on for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes, Saturday still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive if you need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be real kind of you, Rey — I could use the help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, just let me know where you want me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m planning to bring it up at the repair drive and make sure everyone knows what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good idea — I can keep track of what’s still needed and let people know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll bring it up and keep everyone posted on what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going alright so far — folks have been pretty generous. I’m still checking in with people one by one to see what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s good to hear — sounds like people are stepping up. Let me know if there’s anything I can pick up while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I'm happy to help, though I might need a quick reminder of what’s being fixed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re gathering a few neighbors to fix up the little things around the block—loose hinges, squeaky doors, that kind of stuff. I can remind you of the list and we can split it up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That would be great—please remind me of the list, and I’ll take one of the easier jobs so I don’t muddle it up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do we still need to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We still need to sort the donated items and label what’s for the tool shed. I can help if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please—let’s sort them and I’ll grab the labels.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make a clear list of what we need and bring it by tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll keep my toolbox ready. Bring the list by tomorrow morning and we’ll get you sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing—thank you, Mara! We still need a few more volunteers for setup, tool sorting, and handing out flyers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take flyers and help with tool sorting. Just let me know where to show up and when.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I’m glad the repair drive is happening — it’s a good way to pull everyone together. What do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’m keeping track of where everything’s going, so if you can help sort the donation spots and drop-off locations, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help sort the donation spots and drop-off locations so it’s easy for everyone to find their place.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m getting the repair drive organized and wanted to check in. If you’re able to help, I’d love to know what time works best for you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Rosa, I can help in the afternoon or early evening. Just let me know what time you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — afternoon works great. I’ll send you the exact time soon, and I really appreciate your help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting organized soon — I should probably ask around for the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah—do you know when it starts and where people should drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure yet — I only caught that it’s happening soon. I’ll ask around and let you know where the drop-off is.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m in — just send me the repair drive details and I’ll skim them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send over the repair drive details right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — I’ll take a quick look when they come through.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you can help with the repair drive, right?
